purpose: New, non-overlapping public source candidates for the PP-specific Re:Source AI MVP

sources.title: 한국환경공단 재활용가능자원 가격조사 2026-10-26
sources.license: KOGL Type 1 (attribution required) per 2026-10-26 data.go.kr dataset listing
sources.usage: monthly indicative PP recycling material market price; grade/form alignment and regional averages; not facility transaction price
sources.repository_duplicate_check: 2026-09 price reference present; 2026-10 new snapshot not found
sources.caution: Not a signed buyer quote, facility treatment cost, or feedstock-grade price guarantee.

sources.title: Images of PP and PS recyclable waste (updated version)
sources.usage: experimental PP-vs-PS visual material classification; not mass-based contamination percentage
sources.caution: European conveyor RGB/HSI distribution differs from Korean on-site phone images. Cannot infer waste mass fraction from appearance alone.

sources.title: Evaluating the Recyclability and Restabilization of Laboratory Plastics Consumables
sources.usage: PP MVR/DSC/tensile/recyclate-quality research; laboratory plastic consumables, not post-consumer rigid packaging
sources.caution: Autoclaved laboratory PP consumables, not post-consumer rigid PP packaging or domestic industrial waste streams.

sources.title: Losses and emissions in polypropylene recycling from household packaging waste
sources.usage: literature-backed PP recovery and process losses; scenario reference only
sources.caution: Reported 85% yield denominator is pure PP input, not 85% of mixed incoming waste; losses not contamination-removal efficiency.

sources.title: PP Small Rigid Plastic
sources.usage: optional international target specification; not domestic legal or plant acceptance rule
sources.caution: Not Korean law, not a default for domestic industrial PP lots; buyer contract and actual lot testing still required.

sources.title: KS M 3843 플라스틱 — 재활용 성형 재료 — 폴리프로필렌(PP)
sources.format: paid Korean standard PDF (8,500 KRW shown in catalog)
sources.license: copyrighted KS standard; full text needs lawful purchase and rights review
sources.usage: possible normative end-product material quality target if product scope applies; confirm original clauses
sources.caution: This standard addresses recycled PP moulding materials; not a blanket input-waste acceptance standard, contamination threshold, recycling facility approval or license. No full-text copied.
